description: NaMnO₆I is Hydrophilite-derived structured and crystallizes in the trigonal P312 space group. Na is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent MnO₆ octahedra and corners with six equivalent IO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 52-53°. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.40 Å. Mn is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form MnO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent IO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 53°. All Mn-O bond lengths are 1.90 Å. O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Mn, and one I atom. The O-I bond length is 1.88 Å. I is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form IO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and edges with three equivalent MnO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°.
